t: You're standing on South Molton Street, a pedestrianised street in Mayfair running from Oxford Street down to Brook Street. Bond Street Underground station is at the north end. The poet and artist William Blake lived on this street from 1803 to 1820. He's now seen as a seminal figure of the Romantic Age, though he was largely unrecognised in his lifetime. He lived in London nearly all his life, apart from three years in Felpham. His symbolically rich work treats the imagination as the body of God.
